Bryant said these events draw people from both Spokane and out of town.Among the fans gathered to watch the women’s game was Josh Parbon. He said he’s been a longtime GU basketball fan, but he’s become more invested now that his friend’s daughter – freshman Julia Wilson – plays on the women’s team."She's great,” Parbon said. “She's having the time of her life, and just excited to see her in the tournament."Fans will return to No-Li for GU men’s basketball's next matchup against Texas at 4:10 p.m. on Saturday.COPYRIGHT 2026 BY KXLY.
